text:
sara.sales: Incoming RFP from Meridian Health — want capability matrix + security questionnaire answers + a two-track on-prem POC plan. They emphasize dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS/HSM, EU data residency. POC window = 4 weeks. PDF attached.

mike-se: Acknowledged. Need target concurrency / avg token lengths to size. Any mention of acceptance criteria?

sara.sales: Their note says ~200 concurrent users, prompts ~70 tokens, responses ~180 tokens. Target latency p50 300ms, p95 700ms. Acceptance: validation of latency and a demonstration of KMS integration and audit logs.

mike-se: For those numbers, baseline = 2x A100-class GPUs for dedicated, autoscale to 4 for spikes. Air-gapped appliance will likely need higher-spec to meet p95 target. I'll prepare capability matrix with conservative numbers and call out risk.

anya-ops: Clarify deployment options: they ticked both "private VPC" and "air-gapped appliance." We'll need to provide both runbooks and a teardown/data-destruction checklist. Air-gapped requires offline install guide + checksum manifests.

ops-bot: Compliance quick-check: SOC2-TypeII = yes, ISO27001 = partial, FedRAMP = no, KMS integration = supported, HSM attestation = available via partner. Template assets: /sales/rfps/templates.

tess-csm: Let's lock POC success criteria before kickoff: acceptance tests for throughput/latency, end-to-end KMS key rotation test, and audit log export verified. I'll ask Meridian PM to confirm.

dylan-legal: We'll need a DPA and an addendum for the air-gapped deployment outlining responsibilities for key custody, patching, and support windows. Also confirm if they require subprocessor list. I'll draft a redline.

mike-se: Draft CSV snippet for the RFP matrix (to include):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
concurrent-sessions,1000,2500,220,220
p50-latency,90ms,80ms,150ms,220ms
p95-latency,420ms,300ms,600ms,820ms
kms,managed,customer-managed,connector,hsm-offline
data-residency,global,region-pinned,region-pinned,onsite-only
rollout,minutes,minutes,hours,days
```

sara.sales: Mike/Anya/Dylan — please prepare: (1) RFP matrix expanded into readable table, (2) 2-page POC runbook for both tracks (install, smoke tests, perf script), (3) teardown + data destruction checklist with SHA256 manifest template, (4) DPA redline. I'll schedule kickoff for Tue 09:00 UTC.

anya-ops: Will draft teardown checklist and air-gapped install notes (manual key injection, checksum verification, USB transfer guidance). ETA EOD today.

mike-se: I'll produce matrix + runbook draft by tomorrow midday. Note: if they insist on p95 < 600ms for air-gapped, call out need for beefier instance or relaxed SLO.

dylan-legal: Draft DPA redline uploaded to doc and linked here. Will include clause for customer-managed HSM operational responsibilities.

tess-csm: I'll confirm acceptance criteria with Meridian PM on the kickoff call and push for a written success checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder: include billing hooks if customer wants per-token cost reporting during POC. Use /sales/rfps/templates/billing-hook.csv as example.

sara.sales: Great. I've uploaded Meridian_RFP.pdf and contact info. Please review attachments before kickoff. Flag any blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:

mike-se: One more flag: FIPS-only or extra crypto constraints on appliance will add ~2 weeks to build and security review. Call this out as potential schedule risk.

anya-ops: Also flag: if network egress is restricted, auto-update & metrics export won't work; we need manual patch plan and offline metrics export instructions.

sara.sales: Thanks team. Will post the attachments and calendar invite. We'll reconvene after kickoff to finalize deliverables.
